The '''Belthu [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] foundry''' was a facility on [[Belthu]] that refined durasteel in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. After learning it was affiliated with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], [[Wraith Squadron]] arranged to lead [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] to the small, outdated foundry, where an intelligence team blew it up two days after the Wraiths had left.
